title: Bouncer Resolved Policy IR
description: Schema for the ResolvedPolicyIR emitted by the bouncer-md reference resolver. This is the PDP output — the integration surface between the resolver and a conformant PEP.

resolved_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when resolution was performed.

policy_files.description: One record per discovered policy file, accepted or rejected.

controls.description: All accepted and parsed controls from the composed policy set.

resolution_log.description: Audit trail of all resolution events: conflicts, fallbacks, rejections, missing policy.

Outcome.description: A recognized outcome term per §4.4 of the bouncer-md spec.

Priority.description: Enforcement priority modifier. 'immutable' signals Path B enforcement (§4.4).

path.description: Absolute path to the policy file on disk.

accepted.description: True if the file was parsed, validated, and included in the resolved control set.

rejection_reason.description: Human-readable reason the file was rejected. Null when accepted is true.

policy_name.description: Value of the 'name' frontmatter field. Null if the file could not be parsed.

policy_version.description: Value of the 'version' frontmatter field. Null if absent or unparseable.

control_id.description: Stable UUIDv5. Same file path + control position yields the same UUID across repeated resolution runs.

source_file.description: Absolute path to the policy file that declared this control.

name.description: Control name from the '## Control:' heading.

applies_to.description: Bullet items from the '### Applies To' section.

detect.description: Bullet items from the '### Detect' section.

enforce.description: Bullet items from the '### Enforce' section.

outcomes.description: All declared outcome terms from '### Outcome', before precedence resolution. Includes log.

resolved_outcome.description: Session-level enforcement decision — the most restrictive outcome across all controls in the composition, applied uniformly to every control. PEPs MUST NOT assume this reflects only the individual control's declared outcomes.

priority.description: Priority modifier from the control's policy file frontmatter, or null.

capability.description: Reserved for capability abstraction (issue #45). Always null in this version.

source_file.description: Path to the file involved in the event, or null for session-level events.

control_id.description: UUID of the control involved, or null for file-level or session-level events.

controls.name: Access Control
detect: Any attempt to access resources outside the agent scope
